Commentary.Commentary: ..THE CHASE...

Nepal were good with the new ball but as the game progressed, they had no answers to the powerful hitting. Most of their bowlers had high economy rates but the likes of Lalit Rajbanshi and Sandeep Lamichhane were quite decent. Especially the former who was the pick. However, their batters are now left with a tall task. They will have to bat out of their skins if they are to chase it down. Windies on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. Stay tuned for the chase in a bit.

End of another power-packed batting display from the Windies! Yet again, the start was not all that good as they lost three early wickets but then came the stand which turned the tide towards them. It was a massive partnership between Hope and Pooran. The latter was dropped earlier in the innings and he made Nepal pay. Both scored tons and when they were batting 350 looked possible but Windies lost wickets towards the end and they have fallen short of that mark. They though will be very pleased with the score they have on the board.

OUT! TIMBER! Lalit Rajbanshi has been outstanding and what a final over he has bowled. He gets his third. A yorker on middle, Keemo Paul looks to make room and hit it through the off side but misses and the stumps are shattered. West Indies END WITH 339 FOR 7!

Commentary.Commentary: It is time for the national anthems. It will be Nepal's first followed by of the Windies. We are all set now. Brandon King and Kyle Mayers to open for the Windies. Lalit Rajbanshi to bowl first.

Rohit Paudel says they will bowl first looking at the wicket. Reckons there will be help for the seamers and they need to execute their plans. Shares this is a great chance to compete against West Indies.

Shai Hope says they would have bowled first. Feels it is a different surface so they will asses and go accordingly. Informs they are playing the same team. Shares the intent is to score and put on a big total.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Brandon King, Johnson Charles, Shai Hope (C/WK), Nicholas Pooran, Jason Holder, Rovman Powell, Roston Chase, Keemo Paul, Akeal Hosein, Alzarri Joseph.
Nepal (Playing XI) - Kushal Bhurtel, Aasif Sheikh (WK), Bhim Sharki, Rohit Paudel (C), Kushal Malla, Aarif Sheikh, Dipendra Singh Airee, Gulsan Jha, Karan KC, Sandeep Lamichhane, Lalit Rajbanshi.
Toss - Nepal have won the toss and will BOWL first.

Hello and welcome to yet another match in the World Cup Qualifiers where West Indies will take on Nepal. The Windies are one of the favorites to go through the rounds and they started well to win their first game. They are one of the most dangerous sides who have a long batting tail and have enough resources with the ball. West Indies will face Nepal who opened their account after their victory against USA. They are looking like a strong team as well but need to come up with something extraordinary to bear this Windies team. Who do you think will win? Toss coming up...
